label: leaf lamina intercostal region
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0020039 (leaf lamina)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a leaf lamina (PO:0020039) that is the strip of lamina between two adjacent longitudinal veins (PO:0020138), excluding the veins themselves.
reason: A real, repeatedly described region (grasses and other parallel-veined leaves, where indumentum differs between veins and intercostal strips). No PO class and none of the existing region classes (apex, base, margin) covers it. Unlike 'areole' (rejected 2026-11-13), the organ is implied: the leaf lamina. Worth proposing to PO beside central zone of the leaf lamina (PO_0008020).

Narrower: the rays of an umbel or of a Euphorbia pseudumbel ('rays 4-7', whorled from the first node) are its primary branches; PO lists 'primary inflorescence branch' as a synonym of second order inflorescence axis. Do not use the bare word 'ray', which PO uses for the xylem ray.
Exact: spermoderm (French spermoderme) is the seed coat. The qualities seen (parchment-like, corneous, fibrous, colour) are seed-coat qualities.

target: calyx (PO_0009060) in the fruiting stage (context word 'fruiting' -> PO_0001002, pattern 04 state of the bearer)
reason: This is the calyx persisting under the fruit, not a separate structure. Pattern 04 expresses it as a calyx in the fruiting stage. The 'persistent' records are persistence of the calyx.

Narrower: a branch of a cyme inflorescence (PO_0030126). PO lists 'inflorescence branch' as a synonym of higher order inflorescence axis. Where the cyme matters, pattern 12 can add part_of cyme inflorescence.

target: vascular leaf (PO_0009025) part of seedling (PO_0008037), pattern 12 (or with the context stage seedling PO_0007131)
reason: The eophyll is the first foliage leaf of a seedling, a standard character in palm floras (entire, bifid, palmate). A seedling leaf can be expressed as a leaf of a seedling, so a rule is preferred to a new term.
Narrower: a floral disc lining or crowning the hypanthium (as in Myrtaceae and Rosaceae). Diameter and flattening are disc qualities.
Narrower: an oil cell is a single secretory idioblast (Lauraceae, Piperaceae, Annonaceae, Myristicaceae). It is not oil gland PO_0005669, which is a multicellular cavity.

This is the stalk of a stalked cotyledon (French seedling descriptions). Pattern 12 expresses it as a petiole whose whole is the cotyledon. Check that PO's petiole is not restricted to vascular leaf; if it is, use stalk PO_0025066 part of cotyledon.

target: plant organ base (FLOPO_0985024) part of lower petal (FLOPO_0996024, which carries labellum/lip as narrow synonyms), pattern 12
reason: A region (base) of the labellum. The qualities (saccate, cordate, unguiculate, narrow) are base qualities. Labellum is grounded through its existing synonym on lower petal.
The scales of a Fagaceae cupule are its bracts; the cupule class is defined as made of fused bracts. Appressed, acute and tuberculate are bract qualities.

label: spadix sterile zone
parent: same parent as spadix staminate zone (FLOPO_0986101) and spadix pistillate zone (FLOPO_0986105); part_of PO_0030120 (spadix inflorescence)
definition: A portion of a spadix inflorescence (PO:0030120) that bears only sterile flowers or no flowers, lying between the staminate and pistillate zones or between the staminate zone and the appendix.
reason: An Araceae character (cylindric, swollen, length) that completes the two existing spadix zone classes. The bare phrase should be grounded only with an aroid or spadix context. Propose to PO together with the other spadix zones.

Narrower: in Ephedra and Gnetum the integument is drawn out into an exserted micropylar tube (straight, twisted, exserted, length). This is the projecting part of the integument and is grounded on the integument rather than given a new term.

Narrower: the acumen is the narrowly prolonged part of the leaf apex. Bare 'acumen' was rejected on 2026-11-13 because no organ was given; here the organ is named. The examples are largely moss leaves (setaceous, channeled), and leaf apex covers phyllid apex.

label: thallus air pore
parent: is_a PO_0025117 (plant anatomical space); part_of PO_0030027 (thallus)
definition: A plant anatomical space (PO:0025117) that is an opening in the dorsal epidermis of a thallus (PO:0030027), surrounded by one or more rings of epidermal cells and leading to an air chamber, as in Marchantiales.
reason: A standard character in liverwort floras (raised, simple or barrel-shaped, with thickened radial walls). PO has stomatal pore but no thallus air pore, and the two are not homologous. Propose upstream to PO, which covers Marchantia.

target: portion of secretory tissue (PO_0005656) part of hypanthium (PO_0009065), pattern 12
reason: These are glands on the hypanthium. 'gland' already maps to portion of secretory tissue (rule C265), so pattern 12 supplies the whole.

The organ is not given. The examples fit the terminal leaf spine of Agave or Aloe, but floras also use 'apical spine' for phyllaries, fruits, cactus areoles and leaflets. It should be grounded through the organ word, e.g. spine at the leaf apex.

A tube formed by coherent but not fused parts: perianth in some families, petals in Annonaceae, corolla in others. It cannot go under perianth tube (FLOPO_0986010), which is defined by fusion, and which organ forms it depends on the family.

target: plant organ apex (FLOPO_0985023) part of calyx lobe (FLOPO_0986005), pattern 12
synonyms: ápice de los dientes del cáliz
reason: This is the apex region of a calyx tooth, and calyx tooth is a narrow name for calyx lobe. Caudate, spinescent and acute are apex qualities.

target: plant cell (PO_0009002) part of limbidium (FLOPO_0986075), pattern 12
reason: These are the cells of the moss leaf border (limbidium). Unistratose and chlorophyllose are qualities of those cells. This is the same kind of statement as laminal cell (FLOPO_0986100) but is expressible without a new term.
Narrower: a trichome on the ovary wall is a carpel trichome. Length, white, erect and rigid are trichome qualities.

Exact in the examples: German Blattschuppen and fibrous, distant scales counted on the stem are scale leaves (cataphylls). Caution: in English 'leaf scales' can mean lepidote scales on the lamina (trichome, PO_0000282). Use the rule for 'Blattschuppe' and for counted, distant or fibrous scales only.

target: plant organ apex (FLOPO_0985023) part of fruit (PO_0009001), pattern 12
reason: The flat or concave pentagonal end-face of a drupe or phalange (Pandanaceae). It is the apex region of the fruit, and its qualities (concave, pentagonal, puberulent, size) are apex qualities.
Exact: 'fascicules floraux' and sessile, axillary flower clusters are flower fascicles; PO lists floral fascicle as a synonym.

target: plant organ apex (FLOPO_0985023) part of labellum lobe (FLOPO_0986028) in lateral position (FLOPO_0991380), patterns 12 and 18
synonyms: apex of the lateral lobes of the lip
reason: This is a region (apex) of a positioned part (lateral lobe) of the labellum. All three pieces already exist.
Narrower: small calyx lobes ('tetramerous / lobule equal', triangular, rounded). Bare 'lobule' stays rejected as a generic part (2026-11-13); here the organ is named.

label: fruit wing
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0009001 (fruit)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a fruit (PO:0009001) that is a thin, flat, membranous or papery outgrowth of the pericarp (PO:0009084), aiding wind dispersal.
reason: Bare 'wing' was rejected as a generic part on 2026-11-13. FLOPO has seed wing (FLOPO_0986091) and anther wing (FLOPO_0986137) but no fruit wing, and winged capsules, samaras and nutlets occur in many floras. Not for wings formed by an accrescent calyx (Dipterocarpaceae), which are calyx lobes. Propose to PO.
These are trichomes on the stipule. Count per side, glandular and abundant are expressible with patterns 03 and 14. Where the flora says colleters, use colleter (FLOPO_0986023) instead.

'Scale' is a contextual, ambiguous bearer (bud scale, involucral bract, cupule bract, scale leaf, lepidote scale). With 'outer' it is usually a phyllary, which is already grounded as outer involucral bract (FLOPO_0996010, synonym 'outer involucral scale'). The bare phrase cannot be grounded without the organ.

target: whole plant (PO_0000003) with the bearer quality male (PATO_0000384), pattern 04 state of the bearer
reason: Not a separate structure: the context word 'male' already allows 'plant' as its head. In mosses the dwarf males are male gametophytes, and size and colour are qualities of that whole plant.
